edge.$comment: Reverse proxy (Caddy) + DNS automation — see deploy-kit/edge/README.md. deploy-kit/edge/edge.config.json ships neutral defaults (everything off); YOUR deployment's values go in THIS block, which overrides it. Which sites get routed/DNS-managed comes from projects[] entries with visibility:'external' + a 'domain'. Keys starting with $ are comments and ignored.
edge.$enabled: Master switch. While false nothing deploys and no DNS is written — dry-runs (edge:dns:check, edge:generate, edge:preflight) all still work. Flip to true once the dry-run output looks right.
edge.$proxyMode: 'caddy' = the managed Caddy container deploy-kit ships. 'dsm' = keep your own reverse proxy; DNS automation, DDNS, and preflight verification still run against it.
edge.$dnsProvider: Who hosts your domains' DNS: 'porkbun' and 'cloudflare' are built in (add others as deploy-kit/edge/dns/<name>.js). Needs that provider's API keys in config above: PORKBUN_API_KEY + PORKBUN_API_SECRET_KEY, or CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN (scoped Zone→DNS→Edit). 'none' = you manage DNS records by hand; certs then use HTTP-01, which needs public port 80 forwarded.
edge.$anchorRecord: OPTIONAL, e.g. 'home.example.com'. Set: that one A record holds your public IP and every managed subdomain becomes a CNAME to it, so an IP change is a single DNS write. Unset (null): every domain gets its own direct A record and ddns-update rewrites each on an IP change — simplest, fine for a few domains.
edge.$publicIp: 'auto' = detect the egress IP each run (dynamic home connection — schedule ddns-update.js on cron). Or declare your static IP, e.g. '203.0.113.10' — records are then enforced to it.
edge.$tlsMode: 'internal' = Caddy self-signed certs (pre-cutover testing). 'auto' = real ACME certs; uses DNS-01 when dnsProvider != 'none', else HTTP-01.
edge.$zoneProviders: Per-ZONE overrides for domains registered elsewhere than the default provider, e.g. { "another-domain.com": "cloudflare" }. Keys are zones (registrable domains), not subdomains.
edge.$extraSites: Routes for things that are not projects[] entries (NAS apps, MinIO, ...): [{ "domain": "storage.example.com", "upstream": "192.168.1.100:9000", "healthPath": "/minio/health/live" }]
edge.$wsChecks: Preflight asserts a real WebSocket 101 upgrade through the proxy for these: [{ "domain": "api.prism.example.com", "path": "/ws/chat" }]
